reviewer: Independent AI-assisted visual review of all40 assigned candidate crops plus chronological source-context contact sheets, with native crop inspection for blur/boundary cases. This is not expert biological identity certification. The publisher principal ID is used only after following that animal through the first-day clip. No June9 image, embedding, similarity or prediction was used to accept examples. No rejected candidate was backfilled.

secondary_2238_review.decision: Agree with independent cattle reviewer acceptance after inspecting all four native crops and chronological source context. Single principal dark cow, substantial coat-bearing torso, moderate softness visibly less severe than original source row37. Dark unmarked appearance is weak identity evidence; acceptance does not claim the encoder can distinguish this cow. Row37 remains rejected.
